Title: Preferred tool order
Text: Reasoning-first. The orchestrator prepares deterministic crops before dispatch. The skill reads only the provided images and writes one stub.

Title: TASK-enforced
Text: - None. The skill has no `allowed-tools` frontmatter.

Title: Operationally invoked
Text: - None. Crop preparation, validation, and assembly are orchestrator responsibilities.

Title: Expected use of reasoning
Text: Use visual reasoning over the four corner crops and the full-page thumbnail to identify a titleblock and extract visible metadata. Leave unreadable values as `TBD`.

Title: Disallowed use
Text: - No shell commands. - No web access. - No deterministic OCR invocation. - No reading images outside the declared runtime overrides. - No writing outside `OUTPUT_PATH`.

Title: Write boundary
Text: The skill writes exactly one file: `RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH`.
